pulse.text: **Quiet six hours — nothing shipped and the board holds**: Claude Opus 4.8 stays #1 at **AA-Index 56** (v4.1), ahead of GPT-5.5 (55) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (46), with Anthropic still **~98%** on Polymarket to own the best model at June 30. The real drift is in the release clock: **June is now fully dead for GPT-5.6** (by-Jun-30 down to ~14%, June 26 just 3%), and even the **July 31 line eased to 91%** from 94% last sweep as traders spread the launch across mid-to-late July — the 50/50 crossover now sits around **July 10**. **Fable 5's restoration is cooling, not warming**: Polymarket now prices just **29% back by July 1** (79% by July 31), eleven-plus days into the US export freeze and a markedly later read than the 'within days' tone earlier in the week. Gemini 3.5 Pro is still stuck in limited Vertex preview with no consumer GA. Watch mid-July, where GPT-5.6's odds finally tip past even.
